name: Kortech Shieldora
author: kolmic1

sections.description:
Kortech Shieldora is a high-performance security command center for WordPress. It provides professional-grade protection against modern attack vectors without compromising site performance.

This plugin focuses on core system integrity and login security, ensuring your WordPress installation is hardened against the most common entry points for hackers.

Free Core Features:

Brute-Force Mitigation: Intelligent IP lockouts after repeated failed login attempts to prevent credential stuffing.

Autonomous Hardening: One-click toggles to disable the built-in file editor and restrict REST API user enumeration.

Security Command Center: A beautiful, real-time dashboard that calculates a dynamic “System Score” based on your current site configuration.

Live Audit Logs: Detailed tracking of every blocked threat and system event stored directly in your database.

Complete Cleanup: Includes a full uninstallation routine to ensure no data is left behind if you ever choose to remove the plugin.

PRO Intelligence Upgrades:

For high-traffic businesses and e-commerce stores, Kortech Shieldora PRO offers:

Anti-Carding Engine: Protect Paystack, Flutterwave, and Stripe gateways from automated checkout bots.

WhatsApp & SMS 2FA: Military-grade login security using real-time OTP via the Termii API.

Virtual Patching: Automatically protect your site from known plugin vulnerabilities before updates are released.

Geo-Fencing: Block traffic from entire high-risk countries to eliminate 90% of global bot noise.
sections.installation:
Upload the kortech-shieldora folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.

Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

Access the Shieldora menu in your admin sidebar to view your Command Center.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin slow down my site?

No. Kortech Shieldora is designed with a “performance-first” philosophy. All security checks are lightweight and execute instantly.

What happens if I am locked out?

Lockouts are temporary (default 1 hour). If you are an administrator and get locked out, you can wait for the timer to expire or remove the lockout record from the database.
